    M

    Migration - Record Class in org.jwcarman.migratory.core
    A library's declared migration: a Liquibase changelog under a unique name, with the names of the migrations it runs after and before.
    Migration(String, String, Set, Set, String) - Constructor for record class org.jwcarman.migratory.core.Migration
    Creates a migration, copying after and before into unmodifiable sets that keep their order.
    MigrationDeclarations - Class in org.jwcarman.migratory.core
    Reads the migrations libraries declare in "META-INF/migratory.properties".
    Migrations - Class in org.jwcarman.migratory.autoconfigure
    Finds the migrations to run, in the order they run.
    MigrationSorter - Class in org.jwcarman.migratory.core
    Orders migrations so each runs after every migration it names in after, and before every one it names in before.
    MigratoryAotProcessor - Class in org.jwcarman.migratory.autoconfigure
    Bakes the sorted migrations into a native image at build time.
    MigratoryAotProcessor() - Constructor for class org.jwcarman.migratory.autoconfigure.MigratoryAotProcessor
    Creates the processor; Spring loads it from META-INF/spring/aot.factories.
    MigratoryAutoConfiguration - Class in org.jwcarman.migratory.autoconfigure
    Runs the migrations libraries declare in META-INF/migratory.properties at startup, before the application's own Liquibase.
    MigratoryDatabaseInitializerDetector - Class in org.jwcarman.migratory.autoconfigure
    Finds MigratoryLiquibase as a database initializer, ordered ahead of every other, so every SpringLiquibase bean, JPA, and each bean that depends on database initialization waits for the declared migrations.
    MigratoryDatabaseInitializerDetector() - Constructor for class org.jwcarman.migratory.autoconfigure.MigratoryDatabaseInitializerDetector
    Creates the detector; Spring Boot loads it from META-INF/spring.factories.
    MigratoryException - Exception Class in org.jwcarman.migratory.core

    MigratoryException(String, Throwable) - Constructor for exception class org.jwcarman.migratory.core.MigratoryException
    Creates the exception.
    MigratoryFailureAnalyzer - Class in org.jwcarman.migratory.autoconfigure

    MigratoryFailureAnalyzer() - Constructor for class org.jwcarman.migratory.autoconfigure.MigratoryFailureAnalyzer
